no-restricted-syntax.message: Empty catch block. A failure that renders as a zero, an empty list or a green state is a lie about the data: surface it with ErrorState/InlineError from components/ui/Feedback. A comment inside the block does NOT exempt it (that is the hole this rule exists to close) — a genuinely correct discard takes an eslint-disable-next-line above the catch, so every one of them is a line somebody reviewed.
Empty .catch(() => {}) handler. Route the rejection into a rendered error state (ErrorState/InlineError) instead of discarding it.
Empty .catch(function () {}) handler. Route the rejection into a rendered error state (ErrorState/InlineError) instead of discarding it.
